name: Group Agreement
text: Before starting, each participant independently confirms: I want to participate. I understand the selected mode. I can pause or stop my own participation at any time. I know how to communicate a boundary. I can change my mind without pressure. Group agrees on: turn-based/simultaneous/hybrid, rotation order, observation options, excluded activities, STI/toy hygiene, check-in method, ending.
safetyNote: Do not start until everyone has freely communicated preferences.

name: Shared Rhythm
text: Everyone finds a comfortable position and chooses their preferred level of involvement. Timer provides common pacing cue. Each participant follows their own comfort level. No one has to match another's pace.

name: Three-Person Rotation
text: Phase 1: Participant A is focus (2 min). B and C participate per A's agreement. Transition check (30-60s). Phase 2: Participant B is focus (2 min). A and C follow B's preferences. Transition check. Phase 3: Participant C is focus (2 min). A and B follow C's preferences. Group check-in (1-2 min). Order changeable by mutual agreement. Skip turn allowed. Not a competition.

name: Hybrid Connection
text: Phase 1: Shared interval (2 min) - all choose involvement. Phase 2: Focus A (90s) - A chooses attention, B and C follow A's boundaries. Phase 3: Focus B (90s). Phase 4: Focus C (90s). Phase 5: Shared reset (2 min) - pause, communicate changes, decide continue. Focus intervals are invitations, not obligations. Private check-in available.

name: Group Recovery & Reconnection
text: Timer stops all pacing. No new activity. Each participant chooses: comfortable/reconnect | quiet company | space | private talk | practical support. Group may share appreciation, discuss boundaries, or spend time. Optional follow-up request. No one must disclose feelings publicly. Jealousy/disappointment ≠ failure. No obligation to reassure others.
